counterexamples: Saving a new order, or one without line items, ends in the same state.

defects.evidence: orders.py now uses INSERT OR REPLACE; tables.py declares line_items.order_id with ON DELETE CASCADE and enables foreign keys.
defects.fix_or_counterexample: Keep the ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE upsert.
defects.impact: REPLACE deletes the existing order row first; the ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key removes all of its line items.
defects.match_criteria: Identify that REPLACE deletes and reinserts the row, or that dependent line items are lost.
defects.trigger: save_order is called for an order that already has line items.
